# Third-party fixture

`hmem-vectors.json` is an unmodified copy of
`engines/hmem/conformance/vectors/vectors.json` from
[Meterless/Meterless](https://github.com/Meterless/Meterless) at commit
`1742dec56a66e58eef9dda2d2b865823758ca8cd`, licensed under Apache-2.0
(see `LICENSE-meterless`). It is the official H-MEM conformance vector set.

It is committed so `npm test` runs all 13 conformance cases from a clean clone.
To refresh it, copy the file again from a newer checkout of that repository.
